# from-mapped item (map from/tofrom, OpenACC copy/copyout) that the
# host never assigns before the region; a mutant (or compiler) that

# old detector over-listed, plus 2 it missed): each item starts at a
# sentinel the check rejects; tests/engine/test_map_mutants.py keeps this
# list empty.
